item.supply_cart.tooltip1: This cart can hold up to 54 stacks of items
item.supply_cart.tooltip2: It has one seat and can be decorated with a banner
item.hand_cart.tooltip1: This cart can hold up to 27 stacks of items
item.hand_cart.tooltip2: It can only be pulled by the player
item.animal_cart.tooltip1: This cart has two seats for animals or players and can be decorated with a banner
item.animal_cart.tooltip2: It can be also controlled from the front seat
item.plow.tooltip1: This contraption can till the ground, make dirt paths or strip logs
item.plow.tooltip2: It needs the respective tools to work and can be toggled by right-clicking
item.seed_drill.tooltip1: This contraption plants seeds on farmland
item.seed_drill.tooltip2: It has room for 9 stacks of seeds
item.reaper.tooltip2: Only works if the player is sitting on it
message.niftycarts.use_reaper: Sit on the reaper to use it
